findings.message: act1/coast_lobster_pots_a: 45% of its 2 x 2 blocks step more than 10 L off their neighbourhood (Eastward's props median 29 %, the style anchors 28 to 30 %): random value grain, not material
findings.fix: drop the grain to sibling swaps at the same tone; step a tone on at most 10 % of cells, tied to the form (+1 only on lit planes, -1 only in shade); earn the detail with parts, joints, wear and story details (house-style.md 4)

reviewer.note: Round 4 (v5) of docs/reviews/2026-11-04-act1-props.md (068cc974): R4-4: the creels read as golden kegs: square-cornered blocks, pale vertical hoops across horizontal bands (staves), the D end a painted end cap with a slot, no weave. Round the east end into a D of radius half the height, one continuous arch of shade, a weave between the hoops.
